lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters distributed across the mid-lateral flank, forming semi-regular columns posterior to the pectoral fin insertion point.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like visual structure along the upper and mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three horizontal linear features on the upper flank exhibiting a sharp vertical luminance gradient, with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing surface and darker shading on the ventral-facing surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a remora (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral-lateral region just posterior to the pectoral fin axilla.
